newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen staying in range.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen staying in range.

text.p: Cocoa is trading in a range and looks set to stay there, technical analysts said.
Traders said benchmark September was due to open six stg lower.

"Cocoa is trading in the middle of the 1,000 stg to 1,070 stg range which held the market from March to May, before the break up to 1,170 in June," Trevor Neil, senior analyst at Union Cal futures, said.
"This range should continue to hold in the intermediate term."
"Only a break of 995 stg would indicate a sharp move down to support at 910 stg," he said.
A break up through 1,072 would quickly meet more resistance at 1,100. "Only a break of the July 1 high of 1,170 would turn the market firmly bullish," he said.
New York cocoa futures ended broadly lower on Wednesday as local and light speculative long liquidation wiped away all the previous day's gains, traders said.
